\[ C = 2 \pi r \]

\[ C = 2 \pi \times 6 = 12 \pi \text{ cm} \]

Therefore, the total distance traveled by the tip of the second hand in 30 minutes is:

\[ \text{Total distance} = 30 \times 12 \pi = 360 \pi \text{ cm} \]

\[ \boxed{360\pi} \]
